environment.mode: offline RPC with no persisted session
environment.classification: activation lower bound, not Worker readiness

method.preload: A fresh Node process imports Pi main, then waits on a private parent-child IPC channel without invoking main or creating a Pi Session.
method.activation: The parent sends one activation message and immediately submits RPC get_state. Elapsed time ends at the matching successful response.
method.exact_typescript: Pi loads the exact TypeScript extension after activation through its normal -e loader.
method.minimal: Pi activates without extensions or other resources.
method.bundled_inline: Bun 1.3.8 bundles 168 local extension modules. The launcher imports the bundle before activation and passes its factory to Pi main as an inline extension.
method.bundle_command: bun build extensions/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=<temporary>/index.mjs with each bundle_external_packages entry passed through --external

exact_admission_probe.cleanup: Every uniquely named synthetic Team, legacy Task directory, isolated Pi agent directory, and child process was removed after its sample.
exact_admission_probe.warning: This proves an RPC-mode exact-admission distribution. It does not establish interactive TTY parity, terminal reservation, resource-profile parity, or adversarial failure cleanup.

interactive_tui_probe.cleanup: Each sample used an exact no-focus Herdr tab and uniquely named synthetic Team. The controller closed only its created tab and removed every owned Team, Task, agent, activation, and marker directory.
interactive_tui_probe.warning: The Herdr idle interval includes bounded CLI observation overhead. Exact Session binding is the Pi Team Bright readiness signal.

preinitialized_tui_reservation_probe.observation: Creating a replacement Session exceeds the strict target before exact PTB binding. A command that keeps the preinitialized empty Session leaves enough latency budget, but changes the admission ontology.
preinitialized_tui_reservation_probe.safety_gate: Do not adopt direct reservation-Session binding until executable evidence proves all input, tool, provider, foreign-extension, queued-message, reload, and shell paths are blocked before a one-shot fenced activation. Any failure must destroy the reservation.

rejected_or_weakened_paths.typescript_preload_through_extension_loa: Pre-instantiating the extension through Pi's loader did not improve activation and introduced high variance.
rejected_or_weakened_paths.compiled_commonjs_extension: Plain tsc output was slower than the TypeScript loader in this experiment.
rejected_or_weakened_paths.bundle_loaded_after_activation: A bundle alone did not help. Moving bundle import off the activation path was necessary.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A single-use process can move Pi core and exact extension module loading off the activation path. Ten synthetic Team activations reached RPC readiness plus exact Membership, event, and runtime-generation binding at 49.87 ms p50 and 99.57 ms p95.
not_proven: interactive-TTY activation at p95 near 100 ms
no import-time environment or cwd capture
